experiment_id_derivation: FIRST author Mingzhi Yu -> M + Y. The folder is named for the PI (Nan Zhang) and would have given the wrong key. Checked against all 54 corpus Experiment_IDs BY PMID: 42569578 is absent, and no MY_* prefix exists (MO_2026 is PMID 42050330, a different paper).

ENDPOINT.admissible_endpoint: S100P/GAPDH mRNA expression, fold change relative to untreated control (RT-qPCR, 2^-ddCt, TaqMan Hs00195584_m1, GAPDH endogenous control), A549, 48 h (6 h transfection + 42 h)
ENDPOINT.corpus_precedent: LRP6_knockdown_normalized (LL_2012, 112 rows, in vitro) is the existing in-vitro knockdown endpoint; siRNA cargo appears on 3,313 in-vitro rows; A549 appears on 2,569 in-vitro rows across JW_2024/BL_2023/LZ_2025

inadmissible_arms.Cy3-siRNA fluorescence (high and low), 5: F-071: a Cy3 dye on a NON-CODING, NON-TARGETING siRNA reports cargo abundance/uptake, not that delivery worked
inadmissible_arms.in-vivo organ fluorescence (Fig 6): F-071 biodistribution of a labelled cargo; also only 4 formulations, and no per-formulation values are published

structure_sources.CKK-E12: corpus_components.smi - NOT INDEPENDENT, corpus agreement is circular

formulation_provenance._measured_note: every one of the 25 was separately formulated with S100P siRNA and separately assayed by RT-qPCR; none is an attributed or interpolated value
formulation_provenance._design_note: the 864-member virtual library minus the 25; the model predicted size and PDI across all 864 and NO delivery value exists for any of them
formulation_provenance._overlap_note: 13 of the 25 were never made as empty LNPs; their predicted size/PDI came from the model alone. Irrelevant to the admissible endpoint, which was measured on all 25, but it means Fig 4a/5a sizes for those 13 have no empty-LNP counterpart to compare against.
formulation_provenance._203_note: Table S1 gives composition only. No size, PDI or zeta value for the 203 is published anywhere, so Figs 2 and 3 cannot be checked against numbers.

CHECKS._design_level_note: 228 formulations x 4 numeric factors = 912 factor values, every one landing exactly on a Table 1 designed level. This is a real check, unlike the mol%% sum.
CHECKS.mol_pct_sum_to_100: NOT CHECKED AS A TEST - it is a tautology here. Section 2.3.1 states cholesterol is a DEPENDENT variable 'calculated to complete the total lipid to 100%%', so the four components sum to 100 by construction. The four components are ionizable lipid, helper lipid (DSPC or DOPC), cholesterol, DMG-PEG2000.
CHECKS.cross_condition_consistency: 3 conditions over the SAME 25 formulations. The 25 bars of Fig 4c and the 25 of Fig 5a/b/c each match the workbook row of the same number, confirming all three conditions share one formulation set. NO two disagreeing sources were averaged.
CHECKS.figure_verification: Fig 5c y-axis label and its Untreated=1.0 bar independently establish column V's readout; Fig 4c/5a/5b confirm the x-axis block labelling. ZERO values were read off a pixel.

token_pattern_test.E12: 216 rows / 1 structure by substring, but the full-InChIKey join finds 241 across 3 names (CKK-E12, MD-1, 'other') -- the substring UNDER-counts by 25
token_pattern_test.102: 2,327 rows / 16 structures. SM-102's true count is 2,312; the other 15 are A*Iso102DC18 lipidoids where '102' is a component index, NOT SM-102. The wrong-namespace case.
token_pattern_test.MC-3: 0 rows. The paper's own spelling matches NOTHING, for a lipid present 3,098 times under DLin-MC3-DMA / Dlin-MC3-DMA. A name join on the paper's spelling returns a clean, confident zero.
token_pattern_test.MC3: 3,101 rows / 4 structures -- 3,098 MC3 plus MC3-CB1/2/3, which are different molecules. Over-counts by 3.
token_pattern_test.R93 / D04: 0 rows, and they are NOT lipid labels: they are the Irish Eircodes in the authors' affiliations (Carlow R93 N9R3; Dublin D04 V1W8). The triage's label list was reading postal codes.
token_pattern_test.S1 / S2: 0 rows; SI table/figure numbers, not lipid labels.

CORPUS_OVERLAP.benchmarks_top_the_screen: ALL FOUR lipids are benchmarks, so there is no novel chemistry to rank against them. Among the four, ranked by mean relative S100P expression (lower = stronger knockdown): SM-102-named block 0.1801 (82.0% mean knockdown), CKK-E12-named 0.3206 (67.9%), ALC-0315 0.3727 (62.7%), MC-3 0.7509 (24.9%). MC-3, the oldest clinical benchmark, is decisively LAST.

ANCHOR.why: the paper draws no chemical structure anywhere; all four lipids are catalogue reagents
guards_implemented: template provenance: no literal >=25 chars may be a substring of an enumerated SMILES
ANCHOR._vacuity_note: Both guards fire correctly when seeded, but with no stored structure there is nothing for them to protect. Reporting 'C10 clean' here would be the F-013/F-037 mistake: comparing a value to itself and calling it a match.
ANCHOR.connectivity_probe: a constitutional isomer of SM-102 with IDENTICAL formula (C44H87NO5) and exact-mass delta 0.0000000000 Da is separated by full InChIKey and by skeleton block -- the gate tests connectivity, not arithmetic
ANCHOR.stereo_assertions: NOT VACUOUS but NOT INDEPENDENT: three of the four structures carry stereocentres/double-bond geometry (MC-3 is 6Z,9Z,28Z,31Z; cholesterol-free here) and come from the registry, whose InChIKeys match the corpus exactly. Since cKK-E12 came FROM the corpus, its stereo agreement is circular and is not counted.

SEED_HARNESS.writes_to: a tempfile.mkdtemp OUTDIR; the curation folder is listed before and after and asserted unchanged (F-069)
SEED_HARNESS.verdicts_from: returncode of one child process per seed; no pipes (python3 ... | tail returns tail's code)
SEED_HARNESS.uncredited_rule: a seed whose expected METRIC line is absent is reported UNCREDITED, not passed
SEED_HARNESS.uncredited_incident: On the first run, 2 of 6 seeds exited non-zero while their metric line was ABSENT: a downstream KeyError in the ILC discriminator fired before the check did. Per the rule, the seeds were RETARGETED (metrics now print as soon as they are computed, and a broken bijection is reported rather than crashing) -- the gate was NOT weakened. Both are now credited by an observed metric move: design_level_violations 0 -> 1, bijection True -> False.
SEED_HARNESS.determinism: two clean runs byte-identical on 6 tracked artifacts, verified AFTER the seed suite, and identical to the committed folder copies
SEED_HARNESS.measured_sensitivity_limit: the design-level check resolves any factor value off a designed level by >=1e-9; the composition bijection resolves a single changed factor on one formulation (1 of 100 design cells).
